targets.description: AES encryption/decryption pre-request + test scripts, at the collection root

Existing-user login, embedded at the top of collections that need to authenticate independently. Deliberately excludes Onboarding.postman_collection.json — its 'authentication' folder is the different new-user login variant and must never be overwritten by this target.
Fetches and stores senderAccountNumber/senderAccountName/transferCurrency. Appears once per sub-folder in both Transfers (transferv1) and BillsPayment (bills-payment).
